retainNative.excluded: Supplied images, generated image copies, observer executables, temporary paths and SDK binaries; retain hashes/scalar facts instead.

adjacencyBoundary: The old a13-16 native-source receipt is preserved; this gate's new strict native test binds current bounds source and reruns its complete real-image comparison. No old assertion is edited or reported passing without execution.

baselinePreparation.mode: Fresh detached --no-checkout worktree; worktree-local noncone sparse config; read-tree -mu HEAD once only in this fresh tree; no install.
baselinePreparation.aliasRule: Each local node_modules/@sharpforge entry resolves to its own checkout's packages/<name>/src/index.js.

performanceProtocol.approval: No automatic exception or 5% pass; independent review of all favorable and adverse median/p95/p99 costs.
